content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to use a Pt1000 sensor with a different measurement range than -50 to 200 degrees? That range is uncommon for my application. I was hoping to use a [company_name] sensor model. I have attached a program containing some analog blocks. Thanks.

Hello, As far as I know, the [product_name] RTD module only supports PT100/1000 sensors with a specified characteristic (refer to the manual) and only for the range of -50 to 200°C. I hope this information helps.

On the website of [company_name], I found that the sensor model in question is a standard PT1000 type. Older sensors from Landis & Gyr are Ni 1000, which have slightly different characteristics. According to [company_name], it's usable from 0 to 50 degrees, so it should function with your [product_name] and RTD module. What temperature range do you need? You can always calibrate the sensor using an analog arithmetic block. Note: The extension units should end with [article_no] for the newer version, while older [article_no] variants are for previous generations.

Hello, Here is an excerpt from the [product_name] manual regarding the RTD module: [IMAGE] You may encounter issues if you use different sensors. During power-on, the RTD module sends a brief current pulse to detect whether a PT100 or PT1000 is connected to each channel. If a different type is used, the module may not recognize the sensor. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is uncertain about whether the [product_name] RTD module can support a Pt1000 sensor outside the standard -50 to 200°C range, and is concerned about using a particular [company_name] sensor. Replies clarify official support is limited to PT100/1000 sensors with specific characteristics and within the default range, and that detection problems may occur with incompatible sensors or ranges. Users referenced the manual and offered guidance on necessary version requirements for extension modules.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to enable configuration or use of the Pt1000 sensor outside the standard -50 to 200°C range on the [product_name] RTD module, seeking greater flexibility and compatibility.
